# sett

> Design system for tau-rs developer tools: Lit web components (prefix `sett-`), DTCG tokens (CSS prefix `--sett-`), dense, quiet, dark-first, plain DOM. generated by scripts/gen-agent-layer.mjs from packages/ui/custom-elements.json, the Storybook stories index and DESIGN.md. Do not edit; run pnpm build.

Storybook: https://tau-rs.github.io/sett/ · a story is https://tau-rs.github.io/sett/?path=/story/<id> · the stories index is https://tau-rs.github.io/sett/index.json · the element manifest is packages/ui/custom-elements.json (custom-elements-manifest 1.0.0) · the rules are DESIGN.md · the agent brief is skills/sett/SKILL.md.

## Elements

One line per element: tag · what it is · attrs (name=type) · slots · CSS parts · events · the story ids that show each state, with the state in parentheses.

- sett-button: A button. Grid metrics, lowercase, tokens only. A disabled primary is a dashed blue outline at full contrast, never a faded fill. · attrs: variant=ButtonVariant, size=ButtonSize, disabled=boolean · slots: (default) · parts: button · events: none · stories: buttons-buttons--buttons (button · default, primary, quiet, sm, disabled), buttons-buttons--split-agent-first (split · agent first (default)), buttons-buttons--split-me-first (split · "me first" setting), buttons-buttons--split-open (split · list open), buttons-buttons--gated-blocked (gated · blocked with pills), buttons-buttons--gated-open (gated · open), buttons-buttons--hand-back-disabled (hand back · disabled until the note is written)
- sett-card: One card shape for seven uses: fix (dashed blue), plan delta (amber), impact, merge checklist, pipeline, result (green), what's new. A heading with a state (pill) or count (tag) on the right, then rows. · attrs: variant=CardVariant · slots: (default), title, state, acts · parts: heading · events: none · stories: cards-card--fix (Fix), cards-card--delta (plan delta), cards-card--impact (Impact), cards-card--checklist (merge checklist), cards-card--pipeline (Pipeline), cards-card--result (Result), cards-card--whats-new (what's new), cards-card--rows (rows · place, destination, note, none), cards-card--pipes (pipe · states), cards-card--all-seven (all seven)
- sett-card-row: A card row: glyph · fact · where it leads. With `place` (a spot in code) or `nav` (another pane) the whole row is the link: it lights on hover and ends with ›. A place is drawn as the small mono tag; a nav as a grey word. · attrs: mark=string, kind=RowKind, place=string, nav=string · slots: (default), right · parts: none · events: sett-go · stories: cards-card--fix (Fix), cards-card--delta (plan delta), cards-card--impact (Impact), cards-card--checklist (merge checklist), cards-card--pipeline (Pipeline), cards-card--result (Result), cards-card--whats-new (what's new), cards-card--rows (rows · place, destination, note, none), cards-card--pipes (pipe · states), cards-card--all-seven (all seven)
- sett-changed: The line that ends every agent reply: `changed · what`, or `no change` with `none`. · attrs: none=boolean · slots: none · parts: none · events: none · stories: thread-thread--session (session · every content kind), thread-thread--planner (planner · amber top), thread-thread--framer (framer · blue top, witnesses), thread-thread--fixer (fixer · blue top, the finding’s doors), thread-thread--messages (msg · me, agent, sub), thread-thread--tool-and-changed (tool block · changed · no change), thread-thread--question (question · options and later), thread-thread--deviation (deviation · three typologies), thread-thread--verbs (verbs bar · running, paused, taken over), thread-thread--composer (composer · send and hand back), thread-thread--hand-back-moment (hand back · before and after)
- sett-chip: Actions-strip chip: a kind label, a fact, then the verbs. Two doors, agent door first and bold, manual door second and plain (P-1); `me-first` swaps them. A done chip keeps full contrast, its label turns ok with ✓ and it gains a plain `dismiss` verb. Never animates. · attrs: kind=ChipKind, state=ChipState, session=SessionId, me-first=boolean · slots: (default), count, agent, manual, verb · parts: label, verbs · events: sett-dismiss · stories: primitives-chip--default (Default), primitives-chip--git (Git), primitives-chip--agent (Agent), primitives-chip--finding (Finding), primitives-chip--review (Review), primitives-chip--pipeline (Pipeline), primitives-chip--tree (Tree), primitives-chip--normal (Normal), primitives-chip--blocking (Blocking), primitives-chip--waiting (Waiting), primitives-chip--done (Done), primitives-chip--other-session (agent · another session's colour), primitives-chip--me-first (me first · manual door first and bold), primitives-chip--actions-strip (in context · actions strip)
- sett-composer: The composer. `send` is an input and a send button. `handback` turns it into the hand-back note: blue, a few lines, the touched files under it, and "hand back" as its button. · attrs: mode=ComposerMode, placeholder=string, session=string · slots: files · parts: none · events: sett-send · stories: thread-thread--session (session · every content kind), thread-thread--planner (planner · amber top), thread-thread--framer (framer · blue top, witnesses), thread-thread--fixer (fixer · blue top, the finding’s doors), thread-thread--messages (msg · me, agent, sub), thread-thread--tool-and-changed (tool block · changed · no change), thread-thread--question (question · options and later), thread-thread--deviation (deviation · three typologies), thread-thread--verbs (verbs bar · running, paused, taken over), thread-thread--composer (composer · send and hand back), thread-thread--hand-back-moment (hand back · before and after)
- sett-deviation: The agent left the plan. Reason, then the three ways back (and discuss). · attrs: subject=string · slots: (default), way · parts: none · events: none · stories: thread-thread--session (session · every content kind), thread-thread--planner (planner · amber top), thread-thread--framer (framer · blue top, witnesses), thread-thread--fixer (fixer · blue top, the finding’s doors), thread-thread--messages (msg · me, agent, sub), thread-thread--tool-and-changed (tool block · changed · no change), thread-thread--question (question · options and later), thread-thread--deviation (deviation · three typologies), thread-thread--verbs (verbs bar · running, paused, taken over), thread-thread--composer (composer · send and hand back), thread-thread--hand-back-moment (hand back · before and after)
- sett-frame: The one frame that changes colour. Wraps a pane; the slot is the pane's paper. idle grey · live session gradient (rotates) · waiting amber (pulses) · editing sel · collision bad · focus a sel ring at the lit stroke inside the idle frame. The only two animations in the chrome live here; `prefers-reduced-motion` and the `still` attribute stop both. · attrs: state=FrameState, session=SessionId, still=boolean · slots: (default) · parts: inner · events: none · stories: primitives-frame--idle (Idle), primitives-frame--live (live · default session), primitives-frame--live-other-session (live · another session), primitives-frame--waiting (Waiting), primitives-frame--editing (Editing), primitives-frame--collision (Collision), primitives-frame--focus (focus · sel ring at the lit stroke), primitives-frame--reduced-motion (reduced motion · live and waiting go still), primitives-frame--all-states (All States)
- sett-funnel: Onboarding progress: a stepper. A circle per step, ✓ when done, filled for the current one, a number for the rest, a thin line between. · attrs: current=number · slots: (default) · parts: none · events: none · stories: chrome-funnel--default (Default), chrome-funnel--start (step 1 of 5), chrome-funnel--last (step 5 of 5), chrome-funnel--in-welcome-bar (in the welcome bar)
- sett-funnel-step: One step of the funnel. State and number are set by the parent. · attrs: state='done' | 'current' | 'pending', index=number, first=boolean · slots: none · parts: none · events: none · stories: chrome-funnel--default (Default), chrome-funnel--start (step 1 of 5), chrome-funnel--last (step 5 of 5), chrome-funnel--in-welcome-bar (in the welcome bar)
- sett-gated-button: The merge: a primary button that stays visibly primary while blocked, with its reason under it. Blocked = dashed blue outline; reasons are pills, each a link to what unblocks it. · attrs: blocked=boolean · slots: (default), reason · parts: none · events: sett-press · stories: buttons-buttons--buttons (button · default, primary, quiet, sm, disabled), buttons-buttons--split-agent-first (split · agent first (default)), buttons-buttons--split-me-first (split · "me first" setting), buttons-buttons--split-open (split · list open), buttons-buttons--gated-blocked (gated · blocked with pills), buttons-buttons--gated-open (gated · open), buttons-buttons--hand-back-disabled (hand back · disabled until the note is written)
- sett-hint: An inlay hint: rust-analyzer's type hints and arch's own use one shape, a quiet grey pill after the code. `kind` colours the text for the declaration's right-aligned facts (planned, finding, session, blame). · attrs: kind=HintKind · slots: (default) · parts: none · events: none · stories: editor-decorations--syntax (syntax · seven classes at one lightness), editor-decorations--session-working (a session is working · gutter bars, blame on the caret line), editor-decorations--you-stepped-in (you stepped in · blue bar), editor-decorations--planned (a plan targets this item · ◇ and an amber hint), editor-decorations--finding (a finding · wavy underline, ⚠ in the gutter, count in the hints), editor-decorations--witness (a witness · highlighted span, ◆), editor-decorations--cross-repo (a symbol from another repo · italic), editor-decorations--busy-day (a busy day · session, plan, finding), editor-decorations--hints (sett-hint · kinds), editor-decorations--all-situations (all eight situations)
- sett-menu: The list under a selector: rows grouped by what they need from you. Paper, hairline, card radius, shadow. Not a modal: see sett-selector. · attrs: label=string · slots: (default) · parts: none · events: none · stories: buttons-buttons--buttons (button · default, primary, quiet, sm, disabled), buttons-buttons--split-agent-first (split · agent first (default)), buttons-buttons--split-me-first (split · "me first" setting), buttons-buttons--split-open (split · list open), buttons-buttons--gated-blocked (gated · blocked with pills), buttons-buttons--gated-open (gated · open), buttons-buttons--hand-back-disabled (hand back · disabled until the note is written), primitives-selector--default (Default), primitives-selector--main (Main), primitives-selector--yours (Yours), primitives-selector--planning (Planning), primitives-selector--working (Working), primitives-selector--asks (Asks), primitives-selector--paused (Paused), primitives-selector--done (Done), primitives-selector--collision (Collision), primitives-selector--all-states (All States), primitives-selector--other-session (working · another session), primitives-selector--menu-open (menu open · grouped needs-you / working / waiting-to-merge / saved-plans / main), primitives-selector--narrow-menu (menu · narrow, rows never wrap), primitives-selector--reduced-motion (reduced motion · working dot still)
- sett-menu-group: A group in the menu: lowercase title in mute at 10.5 px, then rows. · attrs: label=string · slots: (default) · parts: none · events: none · stories: buttons-buttons--buttons (button · default, primary, quiet, sm, disabled), buttons-buttons--split-agent-first (split · agent first (default)), buttons-buttons--split-me-first (split · "me first" setting), buttons-buttons--split-open (split · list open), buttons-buttons--gated-blocked (gated · blocked with pills), buttons-buttons--gated-open (gated · open), buttons-buttons--hand-back-disabled (hand back · disabled until the note is written), primitives-selector--default (Default), primitives-selector--main (Main), primitives-selector--yours (Yours), primitives-selector--planning (Planning), primitives-selector--working (Working), primitives-selector--asks (Asks), primitives-selector--paused (Paused), primitives-selector--done (Done), primitives-selector--collision (Collision), primitives-selector--all-states (All States), primitives-selector--other-session (working · another session), primitives-selector--menu-open (menu open · grouped needs-you / working / waiting-to-merge / saved-plans / main), primitives-selector--narrow-menu (menu · narrow, rows never wrap), primitives-selector--reduced-motion (reduced motion · working dot still)
- sett-menu-item: One row: dot, name in mono, pill when the branch has a state, then who or how far on the right. Rows never wrap: the name truncates with an ellipsis, the right cell keeps its width and the name's size. · attrs: state=BranchState, session=SessionId, count=number, selected=boolean, still=boolean · slots: (default), right · parts: none · events: sett-select · stories: buttons-buttons--buttons (button · default, primary, quiet, sm, disabled), buttons-buttons--split-agent-first (split · agent first (default)), buttons-buttons--split-me-first (split · "me first" setting), buttons-buttons--split-open (split · list open), buttons-buttons--gated-blocked (gated · blocked with pills), buttons-buttons--gated-open (gated · open), buttons-buttons--hand-back-disabled (hand back · disabled until the note is written), primitives-selector--default (Default), primitives-selector--main (Main), primitives-selector--yours (Yours), primitives-selector--planning (Planning), primitives-selector--working (Working), primitives-selector--asks (Asks), primitives-selector--paused (Paused), primitives-selector--done (Done), primitives-selector--collision (Collision), primitives-selector--all-states (All States), primitives-selector--other-session (working · another session), primitives-selector--menu-open (menu open · grouped needs-you / working / waiting-to-merge / saved-plans / main), primitives-selector--narrow-menu (menu · narrow, rows never wrap), primitives-selector--reduced-motion (reduced motion · working dot still)
- sett-msg: A message. Yours sit on the right in the selection tint; an agent's on the left outlined in its colour; a sub-agent's in the sub shade. Every message opens with an author line: dot, name in the author's colour, time. · attrs: from=MsgFrom, author=string, time=string, session=SessionId · slots: (default) · parts: none · events: none · stories: thread-thread--session (session · every content kind), thread-thread--planner (planner · amber top), thread-thread--framer (framer · blue top, witnesses), thread-thread--fixer (fixer · blue top, the finding’s doors), thread-thread--messages (msg · me, agent, sub), thread-thread--tool-and-changed (tool block · changed · no change), thread-thread--question (question · options and later), thread-thread--deviation (deviation · three typologies), thread-thread--verbs (verbs bar · running, paused, taken over), thread-thread--composer (composer · send and hand back), thread-thread--hand-back-moment (hand back · before and after)
- sett-node: A unit's box on the board, at one of four tiers. The host sets the box and the tier (from the on-screen width, see `tierFor`); the node never resizes itself, the camera moves (rule 3). `mini` is the name only; `chip` adds the meta lines and badges; `card` adds the port rows in two columns and the foot; `sheet` hosts what is inside. · attrs: name=string, kind=string, tier=NodeTier, selected=boolean, focused=boolean, far=boolean, declared=boolean · slots: (default), badges, exposes, needs, inside · parts: hd, ports, foot · events: sett-open · stories: map-node--default (Default), map-node--mini (Mini), map-node--chip (Chip), map-node--card (Card), map-node--sheet (tier · sheet · hosts the inside (lanes 3+)), map-node--on-the-board (in context · a board: one focused card, chips, a far chip), map-op-row--default (Default), map-op-row--routes (route · five methods · return vs → handler · selected), map-op-row--kinds (kinds · rpc, schema, table, flag, text, more · from the fixtures), map-op-row--all-fixtures (in context · every contract of api, as op rows), map-port-row--default (Default), map-port-row--kinds (kinds · eleven, dot colour = kind · both sides), map-port-row--states (states · selected · compact · both sides · api), map-port-row--with-ops (with ops · folded past six with … n more · rg cli flags, api routes), map-port-row--expanded (with ops · expanded), map-rail--default (Default), map-rail--exposes (exposes · rg, api, gpui), map-rail--needs (needs · rg, api, gpui), map-rail--every-section (every section · fixed order, lowercase headers), map-rail--selected-and-compact (states · a selected port · compact density), map-rail--empty (empty · a worker exposes nothing), map-rail--on-the-flat-sides (in context · both rails on a unit, ports docked on the outer borders)
- sett-op-row: One operation under a port in a rail: a route (method chip · path · return or `→ handler`), an rpc (`name(args) → out`), a schema line, a table, a cli flag, plain text, or the `… n more` fold line. One row = `map.size.opRow`. · attrs: kind=OpKind, method=string, path=string, returns=string, handler=string, count=number, selected=boolean · slots: (default) · parts: method · events: sett-expand, sett-select · stories: map-node--default (Default), map-node--mini (Mini), map-node--chip (Chip), map-node--card (Card), map-node--sheet (tier · sheet · hosts the inside (lanes 3+)), map-node--on-the-board (in context · a board: one focused card, chips, a far chip), map-op-row--default (Default), map-op-row--routes (route · five methods · return vs → handler · selected), map-op-row--kinds (kinds · rpc, schema, table, flag, text, more · from the fixtures), map-op-row--all-fixtures (in context · every contract of api, as op rows), map-port-row--default (Default), map-port-row--kinds (kinds · eleven, dot colour = kind · both sides), map-port-row--states (states · selected · compact · both sides · api), map-port-row--with-ops (with ops · folded past six with … n more · rg cli flags, api routes), map-port-row--expanded (with ops · expanded), map-rail--default (Default), map-rail--exposes (exposes · rg, api, gpui), map-rail--needs (needs · rg, api, gpui), map-rail--every-section (every section · fixed order, lowercase headers), map-rail--selected-and-compact (states · a selected port · compact density), map-rail--empty (empty · a worker exposes nothing), map-rail--on-the-flat-sides (in context · both rails on a unit, ports docked on the outer borders)
- sett-option: One option in a question or a deviation: a row that reads left to right, with what it changes on the right (`effect`) or a label on the left (`label`). · attrs: value=string, effect=string, label=string, quiet=boolean · slots: (default) · parts: none · events: sett-choose · stories: thread-thread--session (session · every content kind), thread-thread--planner (planner · amber top), thread-thread--framer (framer · blue top, witnesses), thread-thread--fixer (fixer · blue top, the finding’s doors), thread-thread--messages (msg · me, agent, sub), thread-thread--tool-and-changed (tool block · changed · no change), thread-thread--question (question · options and later), thread-thread--deviation (deviation · three typologies), thread-thread--verbs (verbs bar · running, paused, taken over), thread-thread--composer (composer · send and hand back), thread-thread--hand-back-moment (hand back · before and after)
- sett-overlay-toggles: The row of overlay toggles on the map bar. · attrs: none · slots: none · parts: none · events: none · stories: chrome-tabs-and-switches--tabbar (tabbar · pinned map, unsaved file, session tab, right end), chrome-tabs-and-switches--tab-states (tab · pinned, active, dirty, session, plain), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-fill (seg · fill), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-count (seg · with a count), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-empty-state (seg · a view with nothing in it is never disabled: empty state), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-inline (seg · inline (code · reach) and the reach bar), chrome-tabs-and-switches--toggles (overlay toggles · on and off)
- sett-pill: Status pill: the one way a blocked or waiting state is written wherever its subject is named (selector, menu row, gated button reason, session-card row). Mono, 11 px, never animates. · attrs: kind=PillKind, session=SessionId · slots: (default) · parts: pill · events: none · stories: primitives-pill--default (Default), primitives-pill--progress (Progress), primitives-pill--sug (sug · asks, planned, waiting), primitives-pill--bad (bad · finding, collision, failed), primitives-pill--ok (ok · done), primitives-pill--sel (sel · yours), primitives-pill--session (session · default yk), primitives-pill--other-session (session · another session), primitives-pill--all-sessions (session · all seven), primitives-pill--every-state (Every State), primitives-pill--in-context (In Context)
- sett-pipe: The pipeline bar: one segment per step. `steps` is a comma list of ok | bad | run | pending. · attrs: steps=string · slots: none · parts: none · events: none · stories: cards-card--fix (Fix), cards-card--delta (plan delta), cards-card--impact (Impact), cards-card--checklist (merge checklist), cards-card--pipeline (Pipeline), cards-card--result (Result), cards-card--whats-new (what's new), cards-card--rows (rows · place, destination, note, none), cards-card--pipes (pipe · states), cards-card--all-seven (all seven)
- sett-plan-row: One plan element: glyph, name in mono, and on the right only what the glyph cannot say (asks · n, paused, deviation, you). Sub-agents go in the `sub` slot and fold under the row, folded by default; the row then shows the count and a glyph run. · attrs: state=PlanState, current=boolean, count=number, who=string, open=boolean · slots: (default), sub · parts: row, subs · events: sett-toggle · stories: primitives-session-card--running-with-sub-agents (running · element 3 of 6 · six sub-agents, folded), primitives-session-card--sub-agents-open (running · sub-agents unfolded), primitives-session-card--many-sub-agents (running · twelve sub-agents), primitives-session-card--trouble (asks · paused · stepped in · deviation), primitives-session-card--glyph-column (the glyph column), primitives-session-card--other-session (another session colour), primitives-session-card--reduced-motion (reduced motion · dot still)
- sett-port-row: One port of a unit: the dot on the border (the kind's colour), then `kind · name · count`. On the `exposes` side the dot is on the left; on `needs` the row mirrors and the dot is on the right. Op rows go in the default slot; past `fold` of them a `… n more` row appears until expanded. · attrs: kind=PortKind, name=string, count=string, side=PortSide, format=string, fold=number, selected=boolean, compact=boolean, expanded=boolean · slots: (default) · parts: dot, row · events: sett-select · stories: map-node--default (Default), map-node--mini (Mini), map-node--chip (Chip), map-node--card (Card), map-node--sheet (tier · sheet · hosts the inside (lanes 3+)), map-node--on-the-board (in context · a board: one focused card, chips, a far chip), map-op-row--default (Default), map-op-row--routes (route · five methods · return vs → handler · selected), map-op-row--kinds (kinds · rpc, schema, table, flag, text, more · from the fixtures), map-op-row--all-fixtures (in context · every contract of api, as op rows), map-port-row--default (Default), map-port-row--kinds (kinds · eleven, dot colour = kind · both sides), map-port-row--states (states · selected · compact · both sides · api), map-port-row--with-ops (with ops · folded past six with … n more · rg cli flags, api routes), map-port-row--expanded (with ops · expanded), map-rail--default (Default), map-rail--exposes (exposes · rg, api, gpui), map-rail--needs (needs · rg, api, gpui), map-rail--every-section (every section · fixed order, lowercase headers), map-rail--selected-and-compact (states · a selected port · compact density), map-rail--empty (empty · a worker exposes nothing), map-rail--on-the-flat-sides (in context · both rails on a unit, ports docked on the outer borders)
- sett-question: The agent asks. Each option says what it changes; `later` leaves it waiting. · attrs: author=string, count=number · slots: (default), option · parts: none · events: sett-later · stories: thread-thread--session (session · every content kind), thread-thread--planner (planner · amber top), thread-thread--framer (framer · blue top, witnesses), thread-thread--fixer (fixer · blue top, the finding’s doors), thread-thread--messages (msg · me, agent, sub), thread-thread--tool-and-changed (tool block · changed · no change), thread-thread--question (question · options and later), thread-thread--deviation (deviation · three typologies), thread-thread--verbs (verbs bar · running, paused, taken over), thread-thread--composer (composer · send and hand back), thread-thread--hand-back-moment (hand back · before and after)
- sett-rail: A unit's API block on one flat side: `exposes` on the left, `needs` on the right. Ports go in the slot named after their section; the rail keeps the sections in the fixed order, labels them per side, and hides empty ones. Headers are lowercase and mute. Width is `map.size.rail`. · attrs: side=PortSide · slots: services · parts: header, section · events: none · stories: map-node--default (Default), map-node--mini (Mini), map-node--chip (Chip), map-node--card (Card), map-node--sheet (tier · sheet · hosts the inside (lanes 3+)), map-node--on-the-board (in context · a board: one focused card, chips, a far chip), map-op-row--default (Default), map-op-row--routes (route · five methods · return vs → handler · selected), map-op-row--kinds (kinds · rpc, schema, table, flag, text, more · from the fixtures), map-op-row--all-fixtures (in context · every contract of api, as op rows), map-port-row--default (Default), map-port-row--kinds (kinds · eleven, dot colour = kind · both sides), map-port-row--states (states · selected · compact · both sides · api), map-port-row--with-ops (with ops · folded past six with … n more · rg cli flags, api routes), map-port-row--expanded (with ops · expanded), map-rail--default (Default), map-rail--exposes (exposes · rg, api, gpui), map-rail--needs (needs · rg, api, gpui), map-rail--every-section (every section · fixed order, lowercase headers), map-rail--selected-and-compact (states · a selected port · compact density), map-rail--empty (empty · a worker exposes nothing), map-rail--on-the-flat-sides (in context · both rails on a unit, ports docked on the outer borders)
- sett-seg: A segmented control in a well. Never has a disabled item: a view with nothing in it opens to an empty state instead. · attrs: fill=boolean · slots: (default) · parts: none · events: none · stories: chrome-tabs-and-switches--tabbar (tabbar · pinned map, unsaved file, session tab, right end), chrome-tabs-and-switches--tab-states (tab · pinned, active, dirty, session, plain), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-fill (seg · fill), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-count (seg · with a count), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-empty-state (seg · a view with nothing in it is never disabled: empty state), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-inline (seg · inline (code · reach) and the reach bar), chrome-tabs-and-switches--toggles (overlay toggles · on and off)
- sett-seg-item: One item of a segmented control. · attrs: value=string, active=boolean · slots: none · parts: none · events: none · stories: chrome-tabs-and-switches--tabbar (tabbar · pinned map, unsaved file, session tab, right end), chrome-tabs-and-switches--tab-states (tab · pinned, active, dirty, session, plain), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-fill (seg · fill), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-count (seg · with a count), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-empty-state (seg · a view with nothing in it is never disabled: empty state), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-inline (seg · inline (code · reach) and the reach bar), chrome-tabs-and-switches--toggles (overlay toggles · on and off)
- sett-selector: Branch selector in a pane bar: dot, branch name, a pill when the branch has a state, caret. Click toggles `open`; the `menu` slot (a sett-menu) hangs under it as an anchored disclosure: nothing is dimmed or trapped, Esc, a click outside or choosing a row closes it. · attrs: state=BranchState, session=SessionId, count=number, open=boolean, still=boolean · slots: (default), menu · parts: button · events: sett-open, sett-close · stories: primitives-selector--default (Default), primitives-selector--main (Main), primitives-selector--yours (Yours), primitives-selector--planning (Planning), primitives-selector--working (Working), primitives-selector--asks (Asks), primitives-selector--paused (Paused), primitives-selector--done (Done), primitives-selector--collision (Collision), primitives-selector--all-states (All States), primitives-selector--other-session (working · another session), primitives-selector--menu-open (menu open · grouped needs-you / working / waiting-to-merge / saved-plans / main), primitives-selector--narrow-menu (menu · narrow, rows never wrap), primitives-selector--reduced-motion (reduced motion · working dot still)
- sett-session-card: Pinned at the top of the left pane while a session owns the branch. Header: session name in its colour, the driver, then n/m. One sett-plan-row per plan element. Foot: when it started and a link to the thread. · attrs: name=string, driver=string, session=SessionId, step=number, of=number, running=boolean, still=boolean · slots: (default), foot, thread · parts: header · events: none · stories: primitives-session-card--running-with-sub-agents (running · element 3 of 6 · six sub-agents, folded), primitives-session-card--sub-agents-open (running · sub-agents unfolded), primitives-session-card--many-sub-agents (running · twelve sub-agents), primitives-session-card--trouble (asks · paused · stepped in · deviation), primitives-session-card--glyph-column (the glyph column), primitives-session-card--other-session (another session colour), primitives-session-card--reduced-motion (reduced motion · dot still)
- sett-split-button: The planner's accept: the main verb plus a ▾ that opens a list (the driver) under it, an anchored disclosure like the selector's. · attrs: variant=ButtonVariant, open=boolean, disabled=boolean · slots: (default), menu · parts: none · events: sett-open, sett-close, sett-press · stories: buttons-buttons--buttons (button · default, primary, quiet, sm, disabled), buttons-buttons--split-agent-first (split · agent first (default)), buttons-buttons--split-me-first (split · "me first" setting), buttons-buttons--split-open (split · list open), buttons-buttons--gated-blocked (gated · blocked with pills), buttons-buttons--gated-open (gated · open), buttons-buttons--hand-back-disabled (hand back · disabled until the note is written)
- sett-sub-agent: A sub-agent row under a plan element: glyph and name, same rhythm as the plan rows, running glyph in the sub shade. · attrs: state=SubState · slots: (default) · parts: none · events: none · stories: primitives-session-card--running-with-sub-agents (running · element 3 of 6 · six sub-agents, folded), primitives-session-card--sub-agents-open (running · sub-agents unfolded), primitives-session-card--many-sub-agents (running · twelve sub-agents), primitives-session-card--trouble (asks · paused · stepped in · deviation), primitives-session-card--glyph-column (the glyph column), primitives-session-card--other-session (another session colour), primitives-session-card--reduced-motion (reduced motion · dot still)
- sett-tab: A tab. `pinned` has no close mark; `dirty` carries an amber mark after the name and keeps its close mark; `session` colours the label. · attrs: active=boolean, pinned=boolean, dirty=boolean, mono=boolean, session=SessionId · slots: (default) · parts: none · events: sett-close, sett-select · stories: chrome-tabs-and-switches--tabbar (tabbar · pinned map, unsaved file, session tab, right end), chrome-tabs-and-switches--tab-states (tab · pinned, active, dirty, session, plain), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-fill (seg · fill), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-count (seg · with a count), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-empty-state (seg · a view with nothing in it is never disabled: empty state), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-inline (seg · inline (code · reach) and the reach bar), chrome-tabs-and-switches--toggles (overlay toggles · on and off)
- sett-tabbar: The centre tab bar: map pinned first, file tabs in mono, shortcuts on the right. · attrs: none · slots: (default), right · parts: none · events: none · stories: chrome-tabs-and-switches--tabbar (tabbar · pinned map, unsaved file, session tab, right end), chrome-tabs-and-switches--tab-states (tab · pinned, active, dirty, session, plain), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-fill (seg · fill), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-count (seg · with a count), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-empty-state (seg · a view with nothing in it is never disabled: empty state), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-inline (seg · inline (code · reach) and the reach bar), chrome-tabs-and-switches--toggles (overlay toggles · on and off)
- sett-tag: Small badge: a kind label, a count, a glyph, or a mono identifier such as `service.rs:61`. Sans 10.5 px, radius 3, text only, never animates. · attrs: kind=TagKind, session=SessionId, mono=boolean · slots: (default) · parts: none · events: none · stories: primitives-tag--default (Default), primitives-tag--sug (sug · planned), primitives-tag--bad (bad · finding glyph), primitives-tag--ok (ok · count), primitives-tag--sel (sel · you), primitives-tag--session (session), primitives-tag--mono (mono · identifier), primitives-tag--mono-file-line (mono · file:line, sel), primitives-tag--every-state (Every State)
- sett-thread: One pane shape for every conversation. The top border says who you talk to: the session colour for a session, amber for the planner, blue for the framer and the fixer. Header, scrolling messages, fixed verbs bar, composer. · attrs: identity=ThreadIdentity, session=SessionId · slots: (default), name, context, role, verbs, composer · parts: header, messages · events: none · stories: thread-thread--session (session · every content kind), thread-thread--planner (planner · amber top), thread-thread--framer (framer · blue top, witnesses), thread-thread--fixer (fixer · blue top, the finding’s doors), thread-thread--messages (msg · me, agent, sub), thread-thread--tool-and-changed (tool block · changed · no change), thread-thread--question (question · options and later), thread-thread--deviation (deviation · three typologies), thread-thread--verbs (verbs bar · running, paused, taken over), thread-thread--composer (composer · send and hand back), thread-thread--hand-back-moment (hand back · before and after)
- sett-toggle: One overlay toggle: a small square that fills when on. · attrs: value=string, on=boolean · slots: none · parts: none · events: none · stories: chrome-tabs-and-switches--tabbar (tabbar · pinned map, unsaved file, session tab, right end), chrome-tabs-and-switches--tab-states (tab · pinned, active, dirty, session, plain), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-fill (seg · fill), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-count (seg · with a count), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-empty-state (seg · a view with nothing in it is never disabled: empty state), chrome-tabs-and-switches--seg-inline (seg · inline (code · reach) and the reach bar), chrome-tabs-and-switches--toggles (overlay toggles · on and off)
- sett-tool: A tool block inside a message: mono, one line per call. · attrs: none · slots: none · parts: none · events: none · stories: thread-thread--session (session · every content kind), thread-thread--planner (planner · amber top), thread-thread--framer (framer · blue top, witnesses), thread-thread--fixer (fixer · blue top, the finding’s doors), thread-thread--messages (msg · me, agent, sub), thread-thread--tool-and-changed (tool block · changed · no change), thread-thread--question (question · options and later), thread-thread--deviation (deviation · three typologies), thread-thread--verbs (verbs bar · running, paused, taken over), thread-thread--composer (composer · send and hand back), thread-thread--hand-back-moment (hand back · before and after)
- sett-verbs: The fixed bar above the composer. With a `state`, it draws the take-over verbs: running `pause · stop`, paused `resume · take over · stop`, taken over `stop` (hand back lives in the composer). Without one, the slots draw whatever the identity needs. · attrs: state=VerbsState, subject=string, session=SessionId, still=boolean · slots: (default), actions · parts: none · events: sett-verb · stories: thread-thread--session (session · every content kind), thread-thread--planner (planner · amber top), thread-thread--framer (framer · blue top, witnesses), thread-thread--fixer (fixer · blue top, the finding’s doors), thread-thread--messages (msg · me, agent, sub), thread-thread--tool-and-changed (tool block · changed · no change), thread-thread--question (question · options and later), thread-thread--deviation (deviation · three typologies), thread-thread--verbs (verbs bar · running, paused, taken over), thread-thread--composer (composer · send and hand back), thread-thread--hand-back-moment (hand back · before and after)
